Rey (Marketing): Need a one-pager combo for the webinar assets: security + SLA + deployment modes + quick benchmark bullets. Short, punchy, attachable in confirmation email. Due EOD tomorrow.
Anya (Product): I'll add safe SLA language: enterprise tier options and a short line about latency SLOs (avoid raw kernel/model details).
Keegan (Solutions): Include a tiny decision flow: Regulated -> Private/Dedicated; otherwise -> Hosted/Dedicated. Note KMS/HSM + audit logs.
Sam (Sales): Inbound routing rules: est ARR <10k -> nurture; 10k-50k -> SDR; >50k or private/SLA asks -> AE+SE. Add HubSpot tags: enterprise_interest, private_request.
Pri (Growth): Two benchmark callouts only: Dedicated p99 ~150ms (512 tokens), Hosted p99 ~360-420ms; batching can cut per-token cost ~20-25%. Add footnote: "results vary by workload."
Rey (Marketing): Layout: single column, hero line, three sections (Security, SLA & performance, Deployment), CTAs: Request trial / Schedule consult. I'll draft copy and ping design.
ops-bot: New doc created: /marketing/enterprise-webinar-asset-1770104321 (access: marketing, product, sales)
